Persana AI | The Agent Layer for Modern GTM Teams

AI Superpowered Sales & GTM Intelligence — built on autonomous agents

AI agents that research, enrich, and engage your best prospects — autonomously, not just automated.

The Shift from Tools to Agents:
Your GTM stack is fragmented. Multiple enrichment providers. Workflow tools with hard limits. Manual triggers. Disconnected data. Persana consolidates it all into one agentic platform that thinks, learns, and executes — 24/7.

What Persana Does:
🔍 Multi-Source Intelligence – 100+ data sources tracking funding, hiring, tech changes, real-time intent signals, waterfall data for finding emails, phone numbers and more
🤖 Autonomous Execution – Run complex workflows across 100K+ prospects without manual triggers or platform limits
🧠 Continuous Learning – AI that adapts based on what actually converts to pipeline, not predefined rules
⚡ Native CRM Integration – Bi-directional sync with Salesforce, HubSpot, and your entire GTM stack

Why Teams Choose Persana:

Replace fragmented point solutions with one autonomous platform
- Break free from workflow ceilings and platform constraints
- Access comprehensive signal intelligence across all major data sources
- Scale prospecting without adding headcount

Results Customers See:
✓ 95% increase in qualified pipeline
✓ 65% faster sales cycles
✓ 3+ weeks per month reclaimed from manual work
✓ 30% higher conversion rates

The Technology:

Trained on 700M+ contacts and 200M+ companies, and 100+ data sources. Multi-agent architecture combining research, enrichment, and execution. Proprietary embeddings fine-tuned for GTM use cases.

The Team:

Built by LinkedIn engineering veterans who scaled systems to billions of users. Backed by Y Combinator, Dharmesh Shah, Race Capital, and Stage 2 Capital.

🚀 Join 15,000+ GTM professionals using agents to boost their revenue → persana.ai

launches.title: 🎯📈 Persana AI - Sales copilot to boost productivity
launches.tagline: Persana AI is a sales copilot that easily surfaces unique lead insights and generates personalized outbound in your company's voice.
launches.body:
_TL;DR: Sales teams spend hours researching prospects and writing emails. **Persana AI boosts sales productivity by building a fine-tuned model for your sales team** which combines CRM data with real-time web signals and uses this to easily write hyperpersonalized outbound._

### 👋 Hey YC we're Sriya and Rush and we're building [Persana AI](https://www.persana.ai/)! 

### **❌ The Problem**

In this macro-environment, it is now more important than ever for **sales teams to concentrate their efforts on the most promising prospects** and close more deals efficiently. However data is distributed across hundreds of different touch-points like CRMs and Outreach, causing **teams to lose out on ripe opportunities.** On top of this, writing hundreds of personalized emails across different lead stages is a cumbersome task that takes time away from actually selling to qualified leads.

## **✨ Our Solution**

Persana AI is an AI copilot for sales teams to easily identify promising leads by combining CRM data with real-time signals. The AI can then quickly generates personalized outbound in your company's voice so sales teams can make the most of ripe opportunities. For instance, when a lead visits the company website or gets funding, Persana AI can notify the sales team and generate an email to send out right away.

### **⚙️ How it works**

Persana AI's proprietary engine brings together historical email campaign data, CRM and internal data, and publicly available data points to build a fine-tuned model for the team. Additionally, leveraging Persana's proprietary engine, we are able to identify the leads with the highest likelihood of conversion, allowing sales teams to focus their efforts on these leads and achieve a higher ROI in less time.

## 🎯 **Our Products**

👉 Personalized email combining different sources of insights

### 🤝 Meet The Team

Sriya and Rush met while working at Linkedin where they worked on customer data platform and search teams respectively. Rush has been working in the NLP/gen-AI space for over 4 years and Sriya has been working in the CDP/AI space to help businesses make the most of their data. They’ve launched a successful AI product before and one of the key insights they uncovered was generic AI models don’t perform well for business use-cases - leading them to build Persana AI.
